overview.startPoint: Talk to Summer near the Wilderness wall northeast of Varrock, north of the Varrock Saradominist church.

extra.label: League auto-complete
extra.html: Unlocking Wilderness will auto-complete the quest.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

For Ironman, Albino rat pouches are easily obtainable, as their tertiary ingredient, raw rat meat, can be bought in bulk from the Rufus's Meat Emporium in Canifis or obtained by killing giant rats.

blocks.html: Equip your ghost speak amulet and Talk to Summer at the Wilderness wall, north-east of Varrock.
blocks.text: Equip your ghost speak amulet and Talk to Summer at the Wilderness wall, north-east of Varrock.

blocks.html: Stand on the white portal.
blocks.text: Stand on the white portal.

blocks.html: After the dialogue, equip and right-click operate Jennica's ring while standing on the portal to return to the real world.
blocks.text: After the dialogue, equip and right-click operate Jennica's ring while standing on the portal to return to the real world.

blocks.html: Run northwest, past the dead trees to the dungeon, right-click and collapse the entrance.
blocks.text: Run northwest, past the dead trees to the dungeon, right-click and collapse the entrance.

blocks.html: Go back to the ruins and operate Jennica's ring while standing on the white portal to return to the spirit realm.
blocks.text: Go back to the ruins and operate Jennica's ring while standing on the white portal to return to the spirit realm.

blocks.html: Run north and lure the beast to the entrance with your blue charm familiar. Enter the cave before it has a chance to consume your familiar.
blocks.text: Run north and lure the beast to the entrance with your blue charm familiar. Enter the cave before it has a chance to consume your familiar.

needed.html: Full prayer points for the final phase
needed.text: Full prayer points for the final phase

blocks.html: Avoid the beast's ranged attacks by moving away from the missiles.
blocks.text: Avoid the beast's ranged attacks by moving away from the missiles.

blocks.html: Chop roots along the walls to obtain cursed willow logs. You will need 15 in total.
blocks.text: Chop roots along the walls to obtain cursed willow logs. You will need 15 in total.

substeps.html: (Optional) Right-click use an extra log on the middle fire pit, and then lure the Beast behind it to avoid attacks while cutting the remaining logs.
substeps.text: (Optional) Right-click use an extra log on the middle fire pit, and then lure the Beast behind it to avoid attacks while cutting the remaining logs.

blocks.html: Right-click use 5 logs on one of the fire pits and then light it.
blocks.text: Right-click use 5 logs on one of the fire pits and then light it.

substeps.html: Do not light other fire pits during cutscene.
substeps.text: Do not light other fire pits during cutscene.

blocks.html: Repeat for a total of three fire pits.
blocks.text: Repeat for a total of three fire pits.

substeps.html: If you die during the encounter your progress will be saved but unlit logs will be cleared.
substeps.text: If you die during the encounter your progress will be saved but unlit logs will be cleared.

blocks.html: (Optional) Restock your food and return to Summer to continue.
blocks.text: (Optional) Restock your food and return to Summer to continue.

blocks.html: Enter the next room by going through the passage in the south-east corner.
blocks.text: Enter the next room by going through the passage in the south-east corner.

options.text: Yes, I know what to do.

blocks.html: Avoid the missiles like before.
blocks.text: Avoid the missiles like before.

blocks.html: Soon a dark core will appear, dig soft soil and lure the core into the hole.
blocks.text: Soon a dark core will appear, dig soft soil and lure the core into the hole.

substeps.html: Unlike the previous room, all damage is avoidable in this room.
substeps.text: Unlike the previous room, all damage is avoidable in this room.

substeps.html: Run around the beast to avoid its missiles, but allow the beast to continuously attack without having to chase you to get the dark core to spawn faster.
substeps.text: Run around the beast to avoid its missiles, but allow the beast to continuously attack without having to chase you to get the dark core to spawn faster.

blocks.html: Repeat this 3 times until you receive a cutscene.
blocks.text: Repeat this 3 times until you receive a cutscene.

substeps.html: If you die during this encounter, your progress is saved after each trapping.
substeps.text: If you die during this encounter, your progress is saved after each trapping.

blocks.html: Enter the next room by going through the passage to the east.
blocks.text: Enter the next room by going through the passage to the east.

blocks.html: Take note of which grave the yellow spirit enters.
blocks.text: Take note of which grave the yellow spirit enters.

blocks.html: Wait for the Beast to charge a yellow attack and bless the grave marker.
blocks.text: Wait for the Beast to charge a yellow attack and bless the grave marker.

substeps.html: Blessing a grave consumes prayer points, which may be replenished at the altar in the room.
substeps.text: Blessing a grave consumes prayer points, which may be replenished at the altar in the room.

blocks.html: Repeat for the red and blue spirit.
blocks.text: Repeat for the red and blue spirit.

blocks.html: Talk to the spirits then once outside, talk again.
blocks.text: Talk to the spirits then once outside, talk again.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
blocks.text: Quest complete!

notes: After completing this quest, all the Wilderness spiritual portals are opened. See the Spirit Realm article for more information on Spiritual portals. It also makes available the Corporeal Beast's Lair teleport on games necklaces, regardless of whether or not the entrance is blocked on the spirit realm.
You also gain access to the Rogue jewellery shop.
